description.en: Registers SpecStream as a search and fetch provider on ctx.web and selects it for web_search via cordis.patch.yml, returning answers with source URLs and up to 10 results per query via GET /v1/web-search and optional page extraction via POST /v1/extract. Also registers specstream_research and specstream_research_result on ctx.tools for cited web research reports.
description.zh: 在 ctx.web 注册 SpecStream 搜索与抓取提供方并通过 cordis.patch.yml 设为 web_search 默认提供方，通过 GET /v1/web-search 返回带来源 URL 的回答与最多 10 条结果，并支持通过 POST /v1/extract 抓取正文。同时在 ctx.tools 注册 specstream_research 与 specstream_research_result 工具以生成带引用的网络研究报告。
